# hubverse

> The hubverse is a set of open-source software and data standards for collaborative modeling hubs: repositories where teams submit forecasts or scenario projections in a shared format, which are then validated, stored, ensembled, evaluated and visualised. It is developed by the Consortium of Infectious Disease Modeling Hubs.

This file indexes everything the hubverse publishes. Start with the overview. Each R package site has its own llms.txt that lists every reference page and vignette as Markdown. catalog/repos.json and catalog/sources.json hold the same information in machine-readable form, and catalog/domains.txt lists every domain the documentation links to.

## Overview

- [Hubverse overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-llm-index/main/overview.md): concepts, architecture and which repository does what
- [hubverse.io](https://hubverse.io/): public landing page, quickstarts by role, community
- [docs.hubverse.io](https://docs.hubverse.io/en/latest/): technical documentation for hub administrators, modelers and developers
- [Mailing list and community meetings](https://groups.io/g/hubverse)

## Core R packages

Install together with the hubverse meta-package. Hub administration, data access, validation, ensembling, evaluation and plotting.

- [hubverse](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse): Easily install and load packages from the hubverse; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse/main/README.md
- [hubUtils](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubUtils): Utility functions for Infectious Disease Modeling Hubs; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubUtils/llms.txt
- [hubAdmin](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubAdmin): Utilities for administering hubverse Infectious Disease Modeling Hubs; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubAdmin/llms.txt
- [hubData](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubData): Tools for accessing and working with hubverse Hub data; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubData/llms.txt
- [hubValidations](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubValidations): Testing framework for hubverse hub validations; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubValidations/llms.txt
- [hubEnsembles](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubEnsembles): Ensemble methods for combining hub model outputs; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubEnsembles/dev/llms.txt
- [hubEvals](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubEvals): page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubEvals/llms.txt
- [hubVis](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubVis): Plotting methods for hub model outputs; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubVis/dev/llms.txt
- [hubExamples](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubExamples): This package provides example data for forecasting and scenario modeling hubs in the hubverse format; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubExamples/llms.txt

## Python tools

Python access to hub data and the transform used when model output is mirrored to the cloud.

- [hub-data](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hub-data): Python tools for accessing and working with hubverse Hub data; docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hub-data/
- [hubverse-transform](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-transform): Data transform functions for hubverse model-output files; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-transform/main/README.md
- [hubDataPy](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubDataPy): A Python version of hubData; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubDataPy/main/README.md; archived

## Schemas

JSON schemas that define valid hub configuration files. Versioned; docs.hubverse.io tracks one schema release.

- [schemas](https://github.com/hubverse-org/schemas): JSON schemas for modeling hubs; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/schemas/main/README.md

## Documentation and websites

User and developer documentation, the public landing page, the org profile, and the record of design decisions and project posters.

- [hubDocs](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubDocs): This is the source for docs.hubverse.io. It is built with ReadTheDocs; docs: https://docs.hubverse.io/en/latest/
- [hubverse-site](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-site): Landing page for the hubverse; docs: https://hubverse.io/
- [.github](https://github.com/hubverse-org/.github): Organisation profile; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/.github/main/README.md

## Dashboards

Template, builders and operational workflows for hub dashboards (forecast visualisation and evaluation).

- [hub-dashboard-template](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hub-dashboard-template): Template Hubverse Dashboard Repository; docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hub-dashboard-template/
- [hub-dashboard-predtimechart](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hub-dashboard-predtimechart): An initial dashboard that provides a predtimechart-based forecast visualization component for the hub; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hub-dashboard-predtimechart/main/README.md
- [hub-dash-site-builder](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hub-dash-site-builder): Docker container to build a hub dashboard website with Quarto; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hub-dash-site-builder/main/README.md
- [hubPredEvalsData](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubPredEvalsData): Evaluates a hub's predictions and generates data objects of scores to be displayed on a dashboard using predevals; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubPredEvalsData/llms.txt
- [hubPredEvalsData-docker](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubPredEvalsData-docker): docker container to calculate hub evals data; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubPredEvalsData-docker/main/README.md
- [predevals](https://github.com/hubverse-org/predevals): A JavaScript module for interactive exploration of forecast evaluations; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/predevals/main/README.md
- [hub-dashboard-control-room](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hub-dashboard-control-room): Operational workflows for registered hubverse dashboards; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hub-dashboard-control-room/main/README.md
- [dashboard-test-hub](https://github.com/hubverse-org/dashboard-test-hub): Test fixture hub for dashboard pipeline development (fork of example-complex-forecast-hub); README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/dashboard-test-hub/main/README.md
- [dashboard-test-hub-dashboard](https://github.com/hubverse-org/dashboard-test-hub-dashboard): Test dashboard for dashboard pipeline development (paired with dashboard-test-hub); docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/dashboard-test-hub-dashboard/

## Cloud infrastructure

AWS resources and test hubs for mirroring hub data to S3.

- [hubverse-infrastructure](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-infrastructure): Infrastructure as code for Hubverse AWS resources; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-infrastructure/main/README.md
- [hubverse-cloud](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-cloud): Test hub for S3 data submission and storage; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-cloud/main/README.md

## CI, actions and developer tooling

GitHub Actions for hubs and packages, package scaffolding, pkgdown styling, health checks and R-universe.

- [hubverse-actions](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-actions): GitHub Actions for common hubverse CI tasks; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-actions/main/README.md
- [hubverse-developer-actions](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-developer-actions): GitHub Actions for common hubverse developer CI tasks; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-developer-actions/main/README.md
- [hubCI](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubCI): Toolbox for hubverse Continuous Integration; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubCI/llms.txt
- [hubDevs](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubDevs): Utilities for creating and standardising Hubverse packages; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubDevs/llms.txt
- [hubStyle](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubStyle): pkgdown template and utilities for hubverse docs; page index: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubStyle/llms.txt
- [pkg-health-check](https://github.com/hubverse-org/pkg-health-check): Workflows to regularly check the health of hubverse packages; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/pkg-health-check/main/README.md
- [hubverse-org.r-universe.dev](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-org.r-universe.dev): R-Universe configuration for the HubVerse; docs: https://hubverse-org.r-universe.dev/
- [test-docker-hubUtils-dev](https://github.com/hubverse-org/test-docker-hubUtils-dev): [test] containerized hubUtils (development version); README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/test-docker-hubUtils-dev/main/README.md
- [test-docker-hubValidations](https://github.com/hubverse-org/test-docker-hubValidations): [test] containerized hubValidations; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/test-docker-hubValidations/main/README.md

## LLM harness

Context and skills that let LLM-based tools work with the hubverse.

- [hubverse-llm-index](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-llm-index): Index of hubverse repositories, documentation and linked resources for LLM-powered tools; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-llm-index/main/README.md
- [hubverse-claude-skills](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-claude-skills): Shared Claude Code skills for hubverse development workflows; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-claude-skills/main/README.md

## Example, template and test hubs

Hubs used as templates, examples in documentation and fixtures in CI.

- [hubTemplate](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubTemplate): README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubTemplate/main/README.md
- [example-simple-forecast-hub](https://github.com/hubverse-org/example-simple-forecast-hub): README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/example-simple-forecast-hub/main/README.md
- [example-complex-forecast-hub](https://github.com/hubverse-org/example-complex-forecast-hub): An example of a forecast hub with a complex set of modeling tasks; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/example-complex-forecast-hub/main/README.md
- [example-complex-scenario-hub](https://github.com/hubverse-org/example-complex-scenario-hub): An example scenario modeling hub; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/example-complex-scenario-hub/main/README.md
- [ci-testhub-simple](https://github.com/hubverse-org/ci-testhub-simple): README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/ci-testhub-simple/main/README.md

- [ci-testhub-target](https://github.com/hubverse-org/ci-testhub-target): README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/ci-testhub-target/main/README.md

## Software the hubverse builds on

- [scoringutils](https://epiforecasts.io/scoringutils/): Scores forecasts. hubEvals and hubPredEvalsData score predictions with it; page index: https://epiforecasts.io/scoringutils/llms.txt
- [arrow (R)](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/r/): Reads and queries Parquet and CSV datasets. hubData and hubValidations read model output and target data with it; page index: https://arrow.apache.org/docs/r/llms.txt
- [pyarrow](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/python/): Python library for Arrow and Parquet. hub-data and hubverse-transform read and write hub data with it
- [jsonvalidate](https://docs.ropensci.org/jsonvalidate/): Validates JSON against a JSON schema. hubAdmin, hubValidations and hubPredEvalsData validate configuration files with it; page index: https://docs.ropensci.org/jsonvalidate/llms.txt
- [distfromq](http://reichlab.io/distfromq/): Reconstructs a distribution from a set of quantiles. hubEnsembles uses it for linear pool ensembles of quantile forecasts; page index: http://reichlab.io/distfromq/llms.txt
- [zoltr](http://reichlab.io/zoltr/): R client for the Zoltar forecast repository. hubData uses it to collect forecasts from Zoltar
- [predtimechart](https://github.com/reichlab/predtimechart): JavaScript forecast visualisation component. hub-dashboard-predtimechart builds the dashboard forecast view on it

## R packages that build on the hubverse

Packages outside hubverse-org, on CRAN or R-universe, that import hubverse packages.

- [modelimportance](https://mkim425.github.io/modelimportance/): Measuring Contributions of Component Models to Ensemble Forecast Accuracy. Uses hubEnsembles, hubEvals, hubUtils; page index: https://mkim425.github.io/modelimportance/llms.txt

## Data archives

Historical hubs converted to the hubverse format.

- [covid19-forecast-hub-archive](https://github.com/hubverse-org/covid19-forecast-hub-archive): Archive of original COVID-19 Forecast Hub data in Hubverse format; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/covid19-forecast-hub-archive/main/README.md
- [flusight_hub_archive](https://github.com/hubverse-org/flusight_hub_archive): Hubversion of FluSight 1 (2015-2019); README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/flusight_hub_archive/main/README.md

## Publications and talks

Manuscripts and conference talk materials.

- [hubEnsemblesManuscript](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubEnsemblesManuscript): Repository for "Multi-Model Ensembles in Infectious Disease and Public Health: Methods, Interpretation, and Implementation in R"; README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hubverse-org/hubEnsemblesManuscript/master/README.md
- [hubverse-talk-RSECon26](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-talk-RSECon26): Slides and materials for the hubverse talk @ RSECon26; docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubverse-talk-RSECon26/
- [hubverse-talk-usrse25](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-talk-usrse25): Slides and materials for the hubverse talk @ US RSE Conference 2025; docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubverse-talk-usrse25/
